author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Want to know how to paint a garage door without leaving old paint lines between the panels? I’ll show you how I prep and clean a garage door, spray paint a sectional garage door with the right overlap, paint inside the gaps and cracks, avoid sticking between panels, and finish it off with new trim and weather seals for a clean, professional-looking result.
